test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. 'shot'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **'shot'** implies a rapid and significant increase, which matches the context of the recent rise in tiger numbers.
 
• **'Shot'** adds a sense of significant growth in a short period, reflecting the positive results of conservation efforts.
 
• This word emphasizes the dramatic success in the tiger conservation initiative.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'shot'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Grown'** indicates a natural increase but lacks the emphasis on speed, 'popped' suggests a sudden appearance without sustained growth, and 'expanded' is more suited for area distribution rather than population count.

 

**So the complete passage is - ***The tiger census has revealed that India's big cat count has (1) shot up in the last few years. This is a (2) matter of great hope and relief for (3) those who understand the value of (4) preserving wildlife and the environment. This success is the (5) reward of the collective efforts of the government and the environmentalists.*
